full_judgment: "Mr. Rahimullah Chowdhury and another filed a suit on June 10, 1952 in the Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka for declaration of the title and khas possession of their lands measuring 1.72 acres in the Kakrail area of Dhaka city against two persons, namely, Awlad Hossain and Fazlul Karim on the allegation, inter alia that the defendants had illegally occupied the lands of the plaintiffs. After their death they were substituted by their heirs."
